question: How did Paul say Christ crucified was seen by Jews and by Gentiles?
options: A victory to Jews and a law to Gentiles
A mystery to Jews and a sign to Gentiles
A stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles
A prophecy to Jews and a myth to Gentiles
explanation: Christ crucified was a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles, yet to those God calls He is the power and wisdom of God.
